description: View or change payment preferences and save them so they persist across restarts — no MCP config editing or restart required. Call with no arguments to see current settings. Set "prompt" (ask/auto/off — agent autonomy when switching to a cheaper channel mode), "threshold" (anticipated calls before a channel is worth it), "deposit_multiplier" (x402 channel deposit = call price × this; applies to the next channel opened), "mpp_max_deposit" (MPP session channel deposit cap, in tokens), or "mode" (the default rail+scheme — x402-exact / x402-batch / mpp-charge / mpp-session — also switched live for this session). Pass "reset": true to restore defaults. With an API key, calls are covered by your plan.

deposit_multiplier.description: x402 channel deposit = call price × this multiplier. Minimum 3. Applies to the next channel opened.

mode.description: Default payment rail+scheme the session starts in. Also switched live for the current session when that rail is active.

mpp_max_deposit.description: MPP session channel max deposit, in human token units (e.g. "1"). Applies to the next Tempo channel opened.

prompt.description: Agent autonomy when deciding to switch to a channel mode: ask (confirm first), auto (switch on its own), off (only on explicit request).

reset.description: Restore all payment settings to their built-in defaults (deletes the saved config file).

threshold.description: Anticipated call count at/above which a channel mode is worth considering. Default 5.
